Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the WebSurfer’s findings and incorrectly identified Chian/Chiang Hsiao-chang’s father as Chiang Kai-shek (her grandfather) instead of Chiang Ching-kuo. This led to giving the children of Chiang Kai-shek rather than the “other child” (sibling) of her actual father, yielding the wrong answer.
